page.content:
Showtime Lakers point guard who revived the league with Bird.

How Magic Johnson connects

  • Faction: Los Angeles Lakers — Magic Johnson ran the Showtime Los Angeles Lakers.
  • Character: Larry Bird — Magic Johnson and Larry Bird revived the NBA as paired rivals.
  • Faction: Dream Team — Magic Johnson played on the 1992 Dream Team after HIV disclosure.

What is Magic Johnson?

Magic Johnson led the Los Angeles Lakers' Showtime teams to five titles, a no-look rival to Larry Bird whose 1979 NCAA final and 1980s Finals packed the NBA.

Key threads lead to Los Angeles Lakers, Larry Bird and Dream Team.
